# Contributing

Thanks for helping improve this profile repository. Useful contributions include correcting a broken link, improving accessibility, or clarifying a project description.

## Before Opening a Pull Request

- Keep changes focused and consistent with the information in the profile README.
- Do not add unverified project details, contact information, or credentials.
- Include meaningful alt text for images and SVGs.
- Run `npm run check` after changing Markdown or SVG files.
- Avoid adding dependencies or external assets without a clear reason.

## Pull Request Notes

Explain what changed and why. For visual changes, include a rendered preview when possible. Do not publish private information, credentials, or unpublished project details.

## Security Reports

Please do not disclose security-sensitive information in a public issue. See [Security](./SECURITY.md).
